checklist_item.Text: Every test package that can reach the Landlock probe terminates the hidden probe mode without running tests
Product-side guard: a probe child can never start another probe; hidden mode stays off user-visible surfaces
Probe timeout or cancellation leaves no descendant processes (process-group kill on Linux), with a test
Red-on-main regression test for the recursion, green with the fix; existing probe present/absent tests stay green
Remote gate green with Linux jobs on the self-hosted runners; run id and runner names in the handoff

after.text: internal/scriptworker probe and every test package that can reach it; no workflow or host changes

1. Re-executing any affected test binary in the hidden probe mode exits promptly with the probe result and runs no tests. 2. A probe child cannot start another probe. 3. Probe timeout or cancellation leaves no descendant processes on Linux. 4. Probe present/absent results are unchanged. 5. Regression test red on main, green with the fix; full remote gate green.
